description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Issuance of license to Assetline Finance Ltd. under the Finance Business Act, No. 42 of 2011
categorisation: This gazette content announces the issuance of a license to Assetline Finance Ltd to engage in finance business under the Finance Business Act. This falls under commercial matters involving business registrations, licensing, and financial institution regulations, making it a Commercial Gazette (Type 6). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes or any of the other specialized categories.
